djzc.dialog.root.body2: The tutorial takes about 5 minutes. If you're already familiar with Dong's MC Warfare, feel free to skip it.
djzc.dialog.root.body3: As a developer of Dong's MC Warfare, I feel obliged to warn you: if you don't know this game, you're going to have a rough time.
djzc.dialog.root.title: Want to try the tutorial?
djzc.dialog.tutorial_a.body1: Dong's MC Warfare is, at its core, a capture-the-point game. Capture every marked point on the map and Team T wins.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_a.body2: To save your time, just press the button below to capture this point in one click.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_a.dismiss: Capture A Point in one click
djzc.dialog.tutorial_a.title: Remember, this is a capture-the-point game
djzc.dialog.tutorial_advanced.back: Back to the end of the basic tutorial
djzc.dialog.tutorial_advanced.title: Tutorial - Advanced Tutorial
djzc.dialog.tutorial_b.body1: Since you've made it to B Point, you clearly know how to get to B Point.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_b.body2: You've probably noticed the floating text above each point. In a real match, you can also use %1$s beams to locate points and tell which team holds them.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_b.dismiss: Capture B Point in one click
djzc.dialog.tutorial_b.title: Find the Points
djzc.dialog.tutorial_c.body1: At this point, there's nothing more to say.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_c.body2: Capture C Point in one click, then...
djzc.dialog.tutorial_c.title: Capture C Point
djzc.dialog.tutorial_end.body1: This concludes the basic tutorial. You can reopen it anytime from the Dong's MC Warfare Encyclopedia.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_end.body2: We've also designed advanced tutorials for other mechanics to help you learn the game.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_end.title: What next?
djzc.dialog.tutorial_gui1.body1: Joining CT or T means choosing the defending or attacking side; Class Selection lets you change class and gear
djzc.dialog.tutorial_gui1.title: Dong's MC Warfare Member Handbook
djzc.dialog.tutorial_gui2.body1: The walkie-talkie lets you send quick messages to teammates; redeploying brings you back to the loadout area; stopping music turns off your BGM.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_gui2.title: Dong's MC Warfare Member Handbook
djzc.dialog.tutorial_gui3.body1: Ready means you confirm you are set to start; canceling clears that status. The match starts only once every player on both sides is ready.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_gui3.body2: Now open Class Selection, pick a set of gear, and try it at the range. When you're done, leave through the range exit to finish the basic tutorial.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_gui3.title: Dong's MC Warfare Member Handbook
djzc.dialog.tutorial_skip.start: Wrong button - back to the tutorial
djzc.dialog.tutorial_starter.body1: That's right - just hold %1$s on the starter to activate it.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_starter.body2: Of course, you can also rotate the %1$s on the starter in a few steps.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_starter.title: Activate the Starter
djzc.dialog.tutorial_win.body1: Well done! Winning and losing are common in war — this time you won!
djzc.dialog.tutorial_win.body2: Next up: getting to know the Dong's MC Warfare Member Handbook.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_win.title: Capture D Point
djzc777.load.msg: Dong's MC Warfare - Tutorial System loaded successfully
djzc777.tutorial.end.complete: Click here to ready up a match
djzc777.tutorial.start.denied: A match is in progress - can't enter the tutorial right now.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_starter.body3: If you can't find a starter, check the locator bar on the HUD - the white dot marks the starter.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_d.wait1: To keep you from getting bored while attacking D Point, we wrote some stuff!
djzc.dialog.tutorial_d.wait2: Press G to open the Member Handbook — it covers classes and the walkie-talkie.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_d.wait3: The walkie-talkie sends quick messages to teammates, like 'Attack the D point!'
djzc.dialog.tutorial_d.wait4: Team T wins only after capturing every point on the map.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_d.wait5: Once you're done, head to the shooting range to try out your gear.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_d.wait6: Capturing D Point. Take a look around while you wait.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_d.wait7: Golden carrots, golden carrots — Au Au can't pull them out!
djzc.dialog.tutorial_d.wait8: Enemies inside the point slow down capture. Clear them out first.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_d.wait9: Hold Shift to sneak — your footsteps are much quieter.
djzc.dialog.tutorial_d.wait10: If you can't win, fall back. You can always come back and capture.
